name: What factors should I consider when comparing investment properties with and without HOA fees?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when comparing investment properties with and without HOA fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing properties, consider the trade-offs. Properties with HOA fees often come with amenities and maintained common areas that can attract tenants and potentially command higher rents, but the fees reduce net income. Properties without HOAs offer more control and no direct fee burden, but you're responsible for all exterior maintenance and may lack shared amenities. Your decision should weigh the value of included services and amenities against the direct cost of the fees and your desired level of management involvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare amenities and shared services in HOA properties against reduced net income from fees. Non-HOA properties offer more control but require owner responsibility for all maintenance.
